```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, echo=TRUE)
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(forcats)
require(modelsummary)
require(lubridate)
```

```{r}
bop_panel <- readRDS("~/R projects/MD general/bop_panel.rds")
```

```{r}
# making binary variables
bop_panel$Unification_For <- ifelse(bop_panel$Unification == "For", 1, 0)
bop_panel$Nato_For <- ifelse(bop_panel$NATO == "For", 1, 0)
bop_panel$EU_For <- ifelse(bop_panel$EU == "For", 1, 0)
bop_panel$Eurasia_For <- ifelse(bop_panel$Eurasia == "For", 1, 0)
bop_panel$EU_VS <- ifelse(bop_panel$EU_vs_Eurasia == "EU", 1, 0)
bop_panel$Eurasia_VS <- ifelse(bop_panel$EU_vs_Eurasia == "Eurasia", 1, 0)
bop_panel$good <- ifelse(bop_panel$direction == "Good", 1, 0)
bop_panel$bad <- ifelse(bop_panel$direction == "Bad", 1, 0)
```

```{r}
worry_cols <- c("First_Worry", "Second_Worry", "Third_Worry")
bop_panel$poverty <- as.integer(rowSums(bop_panel[worry_cols] == "Poverty", na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
bop_panel$corruption <- as.integer(rowSums(bop_panel[worry_cols] == "Corruption", na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
bop_panel$war <- as.integer(rowSums(bop_panel[worry_cols] == "War in the region", na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
bop_panel$interethnic <- as.integer(rowSums(bop_panel[worry_cols] == "Interethnic relations", na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
```

```{r}
bop_panel$Socioeconomic <- fct_relevel(bop_panel$Socioeconomic, "medium")
bop_panel$Education <- fct_relevel(bop_panel$Education, "medium")
```

# Direction
```{r}
direction_df <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_bad = mean(direction == "Bad", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_good = mean(direction == "Good", na.rm = TRUE),
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(direction_df, aes(x = date, y = pct_bad)) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Percentage (Bad)")
```

### Macro-Region
```{r}
direction_region_df <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, Macro_Region) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_bad = mean(direction == "Bad", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_good = mean(direction == "Good", na.rm = TRUE),
  )

direction_region_df <- remove_missing(direction_region_df)
```

```{r}
ggplot(direction_region_df, aes(x = date, y = pct_bad)) +
```

## Models
```{r}
good_models <- list(
  "Age" = glm(good ~ Age, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Gender" = glm(good ~ Gender, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Ethnicity" = glm(good ~ Ethnicity, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Language" = glm(good ~ Language_Questionnaire, data = bop_panel, 
                   family = binomial),
  "Ecology" = glm(good ~ Ecology, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Education" = glm(good ~ Education, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Socioeconomic" = glm(good ~ Socioeconomic, data = bop_panel, 
                        family = binomial),
  "Macro Region" = glm(good ~ Macro_Region, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "War" = glm(good ~ war, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Corruption" = glm(good ~ corruption, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Interethnic" = glm(good ~ interethnic, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Poverty" = glm(good ~ poverty, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Year" = glm(good ~ year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "All" = glm(good ~ Age + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + 
                Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + Macro_Region + 
                war + corruption + poverty + interethnic + year, 
              data = bop_panel, family = binomial)
)

modelsummary(good_models, stars = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
```

```{r}
bad_models <- list(
  "Age" = glm(bad ~ Age, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Gender" = glm(bad ~ Gender, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Ethnicity" = glm(bad ~ Ethnicity, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Language" = glm(bad ~ Language_Questionnaire, data = bop_panel, 
                   family = binomial),
  "Ecology" = glm(bad ~ Ecology, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Education" = glm(bad ~ Education, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Socioeconomic" = glm(bad ~ Socioeconomic, data = bop_panel, 
                        family = binomial),
  "Macro Region" = glm(bad ~ Macro_Region, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "War" = glm(bad ~ war, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Corruption" = glm(bad ~ corruption, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Interethnic" = glm(bad ~ interethnic, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Poverty" = glm(bad ~ poverty, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Year" = glm(bad ~ year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "All" = glm(bad ~ Age + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + 
                Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + Macro_Region + 
                war + corruption + poverty + interethnic + year, 
              data = bop_panel, family = binomial)
)

modelsummary(bad_models, stars = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
```

# Problems
```{r}
# mentioning problems across the 1st/2nd/3rd pref
problems_long <- bop_panel %>%
  select(wave, date, id, First_Problem, Second_Problem, Third_Problem) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=c(First_Problem, Second_Problem, Third_Problem),
    names_to = "rank",
    values_to = "problem"
  )
```

```{r}
top_problems <- problems_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(problem)) %>%
  group_by(wave, date, problem) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n))
```

```{r}
top_problems %>%
  filter(problem == "Economy" | problem == "Corruption" | 
           problem == "Standard of living" | problem == "Internal order" | 
           problem == "Corruption" | problem == "Independent Judiciary" | 
           problem == "Peace and understanding among people") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = prop)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~problem) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Percentage")
```

```{r}
# most cited first problem
first_problem <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, First_Problem) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n/sum(n))

first_problem <- remove_missing(first_problem)
```

```{r}
first_problem %>%
  filter(First_Problem == "Economy" | First_Problem == "Corruption" | 
           First_Problem == "Standard of living" | 
           First_Problem == "Internal order" | First_Problem == "Corruption" | 
           First_Problem == "Independent Judiciary" | 
           First_Problem == "Peace and understanding among people") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = percentage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~First_Problem) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Percentage")
```

# Worries
```{r}
# merging categories that are not consistent across waves
bop_panel$First_Worry <- fct_collapse(bop_panel$First_Worry ,
                             "Other"    = c("Other", "Housing", "Education", 
                                            "Lack of social services", 
                                            "Climate change", "Emigration", 
                                            "Low salary/pension"),
                             "Energy/Financial crisis" = c("Energy crisis", 
                                                           "Financial crisis"))
bop_panel$Second_Worry <- fct_collapse(bop_panel$Second_Worry ,
                             "Other"    = c("Other", "Housing", "Education", 
                                            "Lack of social services", 
                                            "Climate change", "Emigration", 
                                            "Low salary/pension"),
                             "Energy/Financial crisis" = c("Energy crisis", 
                                                           "Financial crisis"))
bop_panel$Third_Worry <- fct_collapse(bop_panel$Third_Worry ,
                             "Other"    = c("Other", "Housing", "Education", 
                                            "Lack of social services", 
                                            "Climate change", "Emigration", 
                                            "Low salary/pension"),
                             "Energy/Financial crisis" = c("Energy crisis", 
                                                           "Financial crisis"))
```

```{r}
# mentioning problems across the 1st/2nd/3rd pref
worries_long <- bop_panel %>%
  select(wave, date, id, First_Worry, Second_Worry, Third_Worry) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=c(First_Worry, Second_Worry, Third_Worry),
    names_to = "rank",
    values_to = "worries"
  )
```

```{r}
top_worries <- worries_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(worries)) %>%
  group_by(wave, date, worries) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n))
```

```{r}
top_worries %>%
  filter(worries == "Poverty" | worries == "Prices" | worries == "Unemployment" | 
           worries == "Corruption" | worries == "Children's future" | 
           worries == "Interethnic relations" | worries == "War in the region" | 
           worries == "Energy/Financial crisis") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = prop)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~worries) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Percentage")
```

# Media
```{r}
bop_panel$Trust_Media <- fct_collapse(bop_panel$Trust_Media ,
                             "DK/NR"    = c("DK/NR", "None"),
                             "Internet" = c("Internet", "Social media"))
bop_panel$Important_Media <- fct_collapse(bop_panel$Important_Media ,
                             "DK/NR"    = c("DK/NR", "None"),
                             "Internet" = c("Internet", "Social media"))
bop_panel$Second_Media <- fct_collapse(bop_panel$Second_Media ,
                             "DK/NR"    = c("DK/NR", "None"),
                             "Internet" = c("Internet", "Social media"))
```

```{r}
bop_panel$top_TV <- ifelse(bop_panel$Important_Media == "TV", 1, 0)
bop_panel$top_internet <- ifelse(bop_panel$Important_Media == "Internet", 1, 0)
bop_panel$trust_TV <- ifelse(bop_panel$Trust_Media == "TV", 1, 0)
bop_panel$trust_internet <- ifelse(bop_panel$Trust_Media == "Internet", 1, 0)
```

### Most trusted
```{r}
trusted_media <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, Trust_Media) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n/sum(n))

trusted_media <- remove_missing(trusted_media)
```

```{r}
trusted_media %>%
  filter(Trust_Media == "Internet" | Trust_Media == "TV" | 
           Trust_Media == "Radio" | Trust_Media == "Newspapers" | 
           Trust_Media == "Family" | Trust_Media == "Friends and neighbours") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = percentage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Trust_Media) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Percentage")
```

## Models
```{r}
top_TV_models <- list(
  "Age" = glm(top_TV ~ Age, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Gender" = glm(top_TV ~ Gender, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Ethnicity" = glm(top_TV ~ Ethnicity, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Language" = glm(top_TV ~ Language_Questionnaire, data = bop_panel, 
                   family = binomial),
```

# Domestic politics
```{r}
bop_panel$year <- year(bop_panel$date)
bop_panel$year.f <- as.factor(bop_panel$year)
bop_panel$wave <- as.factor(bop_panel$wave)

bop_panel$Sandu <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Sandu)
bop_panel$Dodon <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Dodon)
bop_panel$Sor <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Sor)
bop_panel$PAS <- as.numeric(bop_panel$PAS)
bop_panel$PSRM <- as.numeric(bop_panel$PSRM)
bop_panel$Putin <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Putin)
bop_panel$Zelenskyy <- as.numeric(bop_panel$Zelenskyy)
```

```{r}
domestic_bop <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  summarise(
    Sandu_mean = mean(Sandu, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sandu_sd = sd(Sandu, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sandu_n = sum(!is.na(Sandu)),
    Sandu_se = Sandu_sd / sqrt(Sandu_n),
    Sandu_lower = Sandu_mean - 1.96 * Sandu_se,
    Sandu_upper = Sandu_mean + 1.96 * Sandu_se,
    Dodon_mean = mean(Dodon, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dodon_sd = sd(Dodon, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dodon_n = sum(!is.na(Dodon)),
    Dodon_se = Dodon_sd / sqrt(Dodon_n),
    Dodon_lower = Dodon_mean - 1.96 * Dodon_se,
    Dodon_upper = Dodon_mean + 1.96 * Dodon_se,
    Sor_mean = mean(Sor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sor_sd = sd(Sor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sor_n = sum(!is.na(Sor)),
    Sor_se = Sor_sd / sqrt(Sor_n),
    Sor_lower = Sor_mean - 1.96 * Sor_se,
    Sor_upper = Sor_mean + 1.96 * Sor_se  
  )
```

```{r}
domestic_bop_long <- domestic_bop %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Sandu_mean, Dodon_mean, Sor_mean, Sandu_lower, Sandu_upper, Dodon_lower, Dodon_upper, Sor_lower, Sor_upper),
    names_to = c("politician", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Sandu|Dodon|Sor)_(.*)"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(domestic_bop_long, aes(x = date, y = mean, color = politician, 
                              group = politician)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = politician), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Mean Score")
```

```{r}
# multilateral vs unilateral support
EU_support <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, EU_For) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n/sum(n)) %>%
  filter(EU_For == 1)

EU_support$Variable <- "EU support (not binary)"

EU_support$EU_For <- NULL

EU_support2 <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, EU_VS) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n/sum(n)) %>%
  filter(EU_VS == 1)

EU_support2$EU_VS <- NULL

EU_support <- rbind(EU_support, EU_support2)
EU_support$IO <- "EU"
```

```{r}
  "All" = glm(Zelenskyy ~ Age + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + Macro_Region + top_TV + top_internet + Unification_For + bad + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + year, data = bop_panel)
)

modelsummary(Zelenskyy_models, stars = TRUE, coef_map = coef_model)

```

```{r}
international_leaders <- list(

)
```
